preconditions.expression: n > 0 and m > 0 and n * m % 2 == 0
preconditions.description: The board dimensions n and m are positive integers and the total number of cells is even.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row of the board has exactly m cells.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in 'UDLR' for row in board for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the board is one of 'U', 'D', 'L', or 'R'.

postconditions.description: The number of distinct photos is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(set(frozenset(free_cells) for free_cells in generate_distinct_photos(board)))
postconditions.description: The number of distinct photos is equal to the number of unique pairs of free cells that can be obtained by removing one domino and making valid moves.
